definition_zh: 支配；主宰；占主导地位；高耸于……之上
definition_en: to control or have power over people or places, to be the largest or most important part of something, or to stand above everything around
core_image: 一个站在高处的主人，把整座宅子压在视野之下，所有规矩由他定。
scene: A single glass tower dominates the skyline of the low coastal town.
sceneCN: 这里 dominate 是「高耸于……之上、成为最醒目的存在」（第 5 个义项：视觉上的主导）；句意：一座玻璃高塔俯视着这座低矮的海滨小城的天际线。场景要点：成片矮屋顶、突兀的高塔、被它框住的天际线。

pos.zh: 支配；主宰；占主导地位；俯视

collocations.zh: 主导谈话；一人说个不停
控制整个进程（比赛、会议）

derivatives.zh: 占主导的；显性的；（生物学）显性性状

senses.title: Rule people or a place
senses.titleCN: 以权力统治：把人或地方压在手下
senses.definition: to have and use power over people, a country, or an organization
senses.definitionCN: 对人、国家或组织拥有并行使支配权
senses.example: For two centuries the empire dominated the whole river valley.
senses.exampleCN: 两个世纪里，这个帝国统治着整条河谷。
senses.why: Dominus was the master of a Roman household, the person everyone else obeyed. To dominate is to act as that master, but on a larger scale.
senses.whyCN: dominus 是罗马家庭里说一不二的主人，其他人都得听他的。dominate 就是把这个主人的角色放大到国家、组织之上。

senses.title: Be the chief feature
senses.titleCN: 成为最主要的特征：别的东西都得让位
senses.definition: to be the most important or noticeable part of a situation
senses.definitionCN: 在某个局面中是最重要、最突出的部分
senses.example: One question dominated the whole debate: who will pay?
senses.exampleCN: 一个问题主宰了整场辩论：谁来付钱？
senses.why: When one member of a household is the master, the household's business is his business. In the same way, one feature can become the 'master' of a discussion and push the rest into the background.
senses.whyCN: 一家之主决定了全家的日程。同理，一个特征可以成为讨论的“主人”，把其余内容都压到背景里。

senses.title: Be the most numerous or widespread
senses.titleCN: 数量或分布上占压倒多数
senses.definition: to be the largest or most common group in a place or system
senses.definitionCN: 在某地或某系统中是数量最大、最常见的一群
senses.example: Tall pines dominate the northern half of the forest.
senses.exampleCN: 高大的松树占据了森林北半部。
senses.why: The master of a house sets its character; the species that fills most of a habitat sets its character too. Prevalence is rule by numbers.
senses.whyCN: 主人定下一座宅子的气质；填满栖息地大多数的物种也定下那片地方的气质。数量上的多数，就是一种“用数目实现的统治”。

senses.title: Monopolize a conversation
senses.titleCN: 独占谈话：不给别人开口的余地
senses.definition: to take up most of a conversation or discussion, leaving little room for others
senses.definitionCN: 占去谈话或讨论的大部分时间，几乎不给别人留空间
senses.example: He dominated the meeting for forty minutes without noticing anyone else.
senses.exampleCN: 他主导会议四十分钟，完全没注意到别人。
senses.why: A room has one master; a conversation has one main voice. When one speaker holds the floor, the others become the household that merely listens.
senses.whyCN: 一间屋子只有一个主人；一段谈话也只有一个主声部。一个人占住发言权，其他人就成了只管听的“家眷”。

senses.title: Tower over the surroundings
senses.titleCN: 视觉上高耸于周围：把风景压到脚下
senses.definition: to stand much higher than the buildings or landscape around and therefore draw the eye
senses.definitionCN: 比周围的建筑或景物高得多，因而吸引全部视线
senses.example: The cathedral dominates the old square from every angle.
senses.exampleCN: 从任何角度看，大教堂都俯视着老广场。
senses.why: Height is the oldest picture of power: the one above looks down on the ones below. A tower that rises over a town repeats the posture of the master at the top of the house.
senses.whyCN: 高度是最古老的权力图像：在上面的俯视下面的。高塔压过小城，重复的正是主人坐在宅子顶端的姿态。

senses.title: Overpower an opponent
senses.titleCN: 在对抗中压过对手：让对方没有还手之力
senses.definition: to play or fight much better than an opponent and control the contest
senses.definitionCN: 比赛或战斗中远强于对手，控制住整个局面
senses.example: The home side dominated the second half and scored twice.
senses.exampleCN: 主队在下半场占据压倒优势，攻入两球。
senses.why: Two households can meet, but only one can be master of the encounter. In sport the stronger side imposes its pace the way a lord imposes his rules.
senses.whyCN: 两家人可以相遇，但一场相遇只能有一个主人。体育里强的一方把自己的节奏强加给比赛，就像领主强加自己的规矩。

senses.title: Prevail in inheritance (biology)
senses.titleCN: 遗传中表现为显性
senses.definition: of an allele or trait, to be expressed even when only one copy is present
senses.definitionCN: 指等位基因或性状，即使只带一份也能表现出来
senses.example: The allele for dark eyes dominates the one for light eyes in this family.
senses.exampleCN: 在这个家族里，深色眼睛的等位基因压过浅色眼睛的。
senses.why: Geneticists borrowed the language of rule: a dominant allele is the one that 'takes charge' of the visible trait, while the recessive one stays out of sight.
senses.whyCN: 遗传学家借用了统治的语言：显性等位基因“掌管”可见性状，隐性基因则退到看不见的地方。

senses.title: Control a market or industry
senses.titleCN: 控制市场或行业：定价格、定规则
senses.definition: to hold the largest share of a market and therefore set its terms
senses.definitionCN: 占有一个市场的最大份额，因而能定下它的规则
senses.example: Two platforms dominate online search across most of the world.
senses.exampleCN: 两家平台主导着世界大部分地区的网络搜索。
senses.why: A market is a household of firms; the dominant one is the master who can set prices, standards, and entry terms for the others.
senses.whyCN: 市场是一群公司的大家庭；主导者就是那个能替其他成员定价格、定标准、定门槛的主人。

senses.title: Fill someone's thoughts
senses.titleCN: 占据某人的心思：挥之不去
senses.definition: to occupy most of a person's attention or emotional life
senses.definitionCN: 占据某人大部分的注意力或情绪生活
senses.example: The fear of failing dominated her thoughts for weeks.
senses.exampleCN: 对失败的恐惧占据了她几周的心思。
senses.why: The master of the house decides what happens inside it. An idea that dominates the mind has become the master of that inner house.
senses.whyCN: 宅子的主人决定里面发生什么。一个念头主宰了心智，它就成了那座“内心宅子”的主人。

intro.en: Dominate came to English from Latin, where a dominus was the master of a household. The word has never lost that picture: someone standing above a group and setting its terms.
intro.cn: dominate 从拉丁语进入英语，那里的 dominus 是“一家之主”。这个词始终没有丢掉那幅画面：有人站在一群人上方，替他们定规矩。

items.en: Domus meant 'house, household'. From it came dominus, generally explained as 'the one in charge of the household' — the master, the lord.
items.cn: domus 意为“房子、家庭”。由它构成 dominus，一般解释为“掌管这个家宅的人”——主人、领主。

items.en: The verb dominari meant 'to rule, to be master'. Its past participle dominatus is the direct source of the English verb.
items.cn: 动词 dominari 意为“统治、做主人”。它的过去分词 dominatus 是英语动词的直接来源。

items.en: Dominium meant 'property, ownership, rule'. Through Old French it produced English domain and dominion, two cousins of dominate.
items.cn: dominium 意为“财产、所有权、统治权”。经古法语，它产生了英语 domain 与 dominion，是 dominate 的两个表亲。

items.en: English dominate is recorded from the early 17th century with the political sense 'to rule'. The word entered through learned Latin rather than through everyday French.
items.cn: 英语 dominate 最早见于 17 世纪初，带政治性的“统治”义。它是经学术拉丁语进入英语的，而不是经日常法语。

items.en: From ruling people the word spread to ruling a landscape (towering over it), a conversation, a market, and finally a set of genes.
items.cn: 从统治人，这个词扩展到压过一片风景（高耸其上）、控制一段谈话、控制一个市场，最后扩展到一组基因。

items.en: Sport, ecology, economics, and genetics all use dominate for 'the strongest or most visible element'. The older idea of mastery survives in every one of them.
items.cn: 体育、生态学、经济学和遗传学都用 dominate 指“最强、最显眼的那个要素”。每一种用法里都还活着那个古老的“做主”观念。

note.en: The first group is the Latin family built on dominus; the second collects words for power and prominence with different scopes.
note.cn: 第一组是由 dominus 构成的拉丁词族；第二组收“权力”与“显眼”类近义词，范围各有不同。

entries.definition: most important, powerful, or common; in genetics, the allele that shows itself. It describes the position, while dominate is the verb of taking it.
entries.definitionCN: 最重要、最有势力或最常见的；遗传学中指显现出来的等位基因。它描述位置，dominate 则是“取得这个位置”的动词。

entries.definition: the act or state of controlling others. It is dominate + -ion, the result rather than the act.
entries.definitionCN: 控制他人的行为或状态。它是 dominate + -ion，指结果而非动作。

entries.definition: the land or power controlled by a ruler. It comes from Latin dominium, the same source as domain.
entries.definitionCN: 统治者控制的领土或权力。它来自拉丁语 dominium，与 domain 同源。

entries.definition: to direct or restrain something. It is broader than dominate and can be neutral, while dominate often carries the feel of unequal power.
entries.definitionCN: 指挥或约束某物。它比 dominate 更宽，也可中性；dominate 常带权力不平等的意味。

entries.definition: to prove stronger in the end, especially after a struggle. It stresses the outcome, not the ongoing grip.
entries.definitionCN: 最终证明更强，尤其在争斗之后。它强调结果，而不是持续的掌控。

entries.definition: to be so impressive or large that others seem unimportant. It is close to the skyline sense of dominate.
entries.definitionCN: 大到或出色到让其他显得不重要。它接近 dominate 的“天际线”义。

entries.definition: to keep all of something for oneself. It fits the talk sense of dominate, but not the skyline sense.
entries.definitionCN: 把某物全部占为己有。它适用于 dominate 的谈话义，但不适用于天际线义。

normalIntro.en: Real parts and relatives: Latin domus 'house', dominus 'master', and the family dominant, dominion, domain, predominate.
normalIntro.cn: 只用真实成分与同族词：拉丁语 domus“家”、dominus“主人”，以及 dominant、dominion、domain、predominate 词族。

normal.en: Dominus was the master of the house; dominate is to be that master in a country, a market, or a conversation.
normal.cn: dominus 是一宅之主；dominate 就是在国家、市场或谈话里当那个主人。

normal.en: The domin- family stays together: dominant (adj.), dominance (n.), domination (n.), dominion (territory).
normal.cn: domin- 词族成串记：dominant（形容词）、dominance（名词）、domination（名词）、dominion（领地）。

normal.en: A tower that dominates a skyline is simply a 'master of the house' made of glass and steel.
normal.cn: 俯视天际线的高塔，不过是用玻璃和钢做成的“一家之主”。

normal.en: In a debate, the person who dominates is the one whose voice sets the household rules.
normal.cn: 辩论里 dominate 的那个人，就是用声音替全场定家规的人。

normal.en: A dominant gene is the one that 'runs the house' of the visible trait, while the recessive one waits out of sight.
normal.cn: 显性基因就是“掌管”可见性状那座宅子的基因，隐性基因则在看不见的地方等着。

abstract.en: Power is a rooftop: whoever stands on it decides what the street below looks like.
abstract.cn: 权力是一块屋顶：谁站上去，谁就决定下面的街道看起来是什么样。

abstract.en: To dominate is to write the first line of a story that everyone else must read.
abstract.cn: 支配，就是替一个故事写下第一行，然后让所有人都得读下去。

abstract.en: Dominance is not loudness; it is the frame that other things quietly fit inside.
abstract.cn: 支配不是音量，而是一个框子，别的东西只能安静地嵌在里面。

examples.en: A few large firms dominate the global shipping industry.
examples.cn: 少数几家大公司主导着全球航运业。

examples.en: The mountain dominates the valley and can be seen from every village.
examples.cn: 这座山俯视着山谷，从每个村庄都能看见。

examples.en: Try not to let one mistake dominate your memory of the whole trip.
examples.cn: 别让一个错误占据你对整趟旅行的记忆。

dict_mnemonic.text: “多米内特”——多米内特站在屋顶，对全城发号施令 → dominate 支配、俯视

root: 拉丁语 dominus“一家之主”来自 domus“家”，动词 dominari“统治”；核心是“以主人身份站在高处，替整个局面定规矩”。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses of dominate, all built on one posture: a master standing above a household and setting its terms.
sensesIntro.cn: dominate 的九个义项都建立在一个姿态上：主人站在家宅上方，替它定规矩。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a master standing at the top of a household, everything below arranged by his word.
core.cn: 核心意象：主人站在家宅顶端，下面的一切按他的话排列。

chain: BE THE CHIEF OR LARGEST PART

branches.en: POWER: a ruler over a region and a firm over a market are the same master at different scales.
branches.cn: 权力：统治一片地区的君主与主导一个市场的公司，是不同尺度上的同一个主人。

branches.en: ATTENTION: the chief feature of a debate and a fear in a mind both push everything else to the edge.
branches.cn: 注意力：辩论的主议题与心里的恐惧，都把其他东西推到边缘。

branches.en: PREVALENCE: the commonest species, the loudest speaker, and the stronger team all win by imposing their pattern.
branches.cn: 优势：最常见的物种、最响的发言者、更强的一方，都靠强加自己的模式取胜。

branches.en: HEIGHT: a building that rises over a town repeats the master's elevated position in stone.
branches.cn: 高度：高过小城的建筑，用石头重复了主人居高临下的位置。

branches.en: INHERITANCE: a dominant allele is the one that takes charge of the visible trait.
branches.cn: 遗传：显性等位基因就是“掌管”可见性状的那一个。

intro.en: Dominate is a Latin verb with a productive family. The base domin- carries 'master, rule'; suffixes mark the person, the state, the act, and the territory.
intro.cn: dominate 是一个有能产词族的拉丁动词。词基 domin- 携带“主人、统治”；后缀分别标记人、状态、行为与领地。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base is dominus 'master', with the verb dominari and the abstract noun dominium. These are the reliable classical forms behind the English family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词基是 dominus“主人”，并有动词 dominari 与抽象名词 dominium。这些是英语词族背后可靠的古典形式。

items.meaning: the act or state of controlling others
items.meaningCN: 支配、控制的行为或状态（-ion 构成行为名词）
items.example: The party's domination of local politics lasted thirty years.
items.exampleCN: 该党对地方政治的控制持续了三十年。

items.meaning: ruling, chief, or most prominent
items.meaningCN: 统治的、首要的、最突出的（-ant 构成形容词）
items.example: English is the dominant language in international science.
items.exampleCN: 英语是国际科学中的主导语言。

items.meaning: the state of being in control or most powerful
items.meaningCN: 处于控制或最强地位的状态（-ce 构成状态名词）
items.example: The two males fought for dominance in the group.
items.exampleCN: 两只雄性为群体中的支配地位而争斗。

items.meaning: one who dominates
items.meaningCN: 支配者、控制者（-or 构成施事名词）
items.example: In the model, one player acts as the dominator and the other as the responder.
items.exampleCN: 在这个模型里，一方扮演支配者，另一方扮演回应者。

items.meaning: to be the strongest or most numerous
items.meaningCN: 占优势、占多数（pre- 表示“在前、在上”）
items.example: Oak and beech predominate in this part of the forest.
items.exampleCN: 这片森林里橡树和山毛榉占多数。

items.meaning: most common or most noticeable
items.meaningCN: 占主导的、最显著的
items.example: The predominant colour of the room is pale grey.
items.exampleCN: 这个房间的主色调是浅灰色。

items.meaning: territory or authority under one ruler
items.meaningCN: 一个统治者下的领土或权威
items.example: The island was once a dominion of the crown.
items.exampleCN: 这座岛曾是王室的领地。

items.meaning: an area of land, knowledge, or activity under one control
items.meaningCN: 由一方控制的土地、知识或活动领域
items.example: Tax policy lies outside the domain of this committee.
items.exampleCN: 税收政策不属于这个委员会的范围。

items.meaning: ownership, property, lordship
items.meaningCN: 所有权、财产、领主地位
items.example: Medieval lawyers distinguished dominium from simple possession.
items.exampleCN: 中世纪法学家把所有权与单纯占有区分开。

items.meaning: a woman who exercises dominant control
items.meaningCN: 行使支配控制的女性
items.example: The word dominatrix is a Latin feminine form of dominator.
items.exampleCN: dominatrix 是 dominator 的拉丁语阴性形式。

definition_zh: 草稿；草图；征召；选派；气流；汇票；起草；抽调
definition_en: a first rough version of a text or plan, a selection of people for service or a team, a current of air, or the act of drawing something up
core_image: 一支笔把散乱的念头拉成一条线，先拉出一个能改的粗形。
scene: At midnight she read the first draft of her speech and crossed out half of it.
sceneCN: 这里 draft 是「尚未定稿的初稿」（第 1 个义项：文字草稿）；句意：午夜她读着演讲稿的初稿，划掉了一半。场景要点：台灯、改得密密麻麻的纸、还没定下来的句子。

pos.zh: 草稿；草图；征召；气流；汇票；（船）吃水
起草；征召；选派
役用的；散装（从桶中打出）的

senses.title: A first rough version
senses.titleCN: 初稿：先拉出一个能改的粗形
senses.definition: a first version of a piece of writing or a plan, made to be revised later
senses.definitionCN: 文字或方案的第一版，目的就是留待以后修改
senses.example: The report is still a draft; nothing in it is final.
senses.exampleCN: 这份报告仍是草稿，里面没有定稿的内容。
senses.why: The old verb dragan meant 'to draw, to pull'. A draft is what you get when you pull ideas into a first shape — a shape you can still redraw.
senses.whyCN: 古动词 dragan 意为“拉、拖”。draft 就是把念头先拉成一个形状的结果，而这个形状还可以重画。

senses.title: A technical sketch or plan
senses.titleCN: 草图、图纸：把构想先落到纸面
senses.definition: a detailed drawing or plan that shows how something will be built
senses.definitionCN: 说明某物将如何建造的详细图样或方案
senses.example: The engineer checked the draft of the bridge before construction began.
senses.exampleCN: 动工前，工程师检查了桥梁的图纸。
senses.why: Before a building exists, it is drawn. The drawing is a 'pull' of the future object onto paper, so the same word covers written and visual first versions.
senses.whyCN: 建筑存在之前，先被画出来。图纸是把未来的物体“拉”到纸上，所以同一个词既指文字初稿，也指视觉草图。

senses.title: Compulsory military service
senses.titleCN: 征兵：把人从人群中“拉”出来
senses.definition: a system that requires people to join the armed forces, or the call itself
senses.definitionCN: 强制人们入伍的制度，或这一次征召
senses.example: He was called up in the draft at the age of nineteen.
senses.exampleCN: 他十九岁时被征召入伍。
senses.why: Drafting soldiers originally meant drawing men out of the general population, as one draws water from a well. The state pulls a few out and sends them to service.
senses.whyCN: 征召士兵原意是把人从总人口里“抽出来”，就像从井里打水。国家抽出少数人，把他们送去服役。

senses.title: Selection of players (sports)
senses.titleCN: 选秀：把新球员从人群中挑出来
senses.definition: an event in which teams take turns selecting new players from a pool
senses.definitionCN: 各队轮流从候选 pool 中挑选新球员的机制
senses.example: The club used its first draft pick on a twenty-year-old goalkeeper.
senses.exampleCN: 这家俱乐部把首轮选秀权用在了一名二十岁的门将身上。
senses.why: The sports draft is the same gesture as military drafting: a body is drawn out of a larger pool and assigned to a team. Only the purpose changed, from war to play.
senses.whyCN: 体育选秀与征兵是同一个动作：把一个人从更大的池子里抽出来，分配到一支队伍。只是目的从战争换成了比赛。

senses.title: A current of air
senses.titleCN: 穿堂风：空气被从缝隙里拉进来
senses.definition: a flow of cold air coming into a room through a gap
senses.definitionCN: 从缝隙进入房间的一股冷空气
senses.example: A draft under the door made the whole room cold.
senses.exampleCN: 门底下的一股穿堂风把整个房间弄冷了。
senses.why: Air is drawn through an opening the way liquid is drawn through a pipe. English uses draft for the pull of air; British English usually spells it draught.
senses.whyCN: 空气被从开口处“拉”进来，就像液体被从管子里抽出。英语用 draft 指空气的抽动；英式英语通常拼作 draught。

senses.title: Beer drawn from a tap
senses.titleCN: 扎啤：从桶里现打出来
senses.definition: beer stored in a large container and served from a tap rather than a bottle
senses.definitionCN: 存在大桶里、从龙头现打出来而非瓶装的啤酒
senses.example: They serve draft beer in tall glasses at the corner pub.
senses.exampleCN: 街角酒馆用高玻璃杯供应扎啤。
senses.why: Draft beer is literally drawn from the cask through a tap, so the old sense 'something drawn out of a container' survives in this everyday phrase.
senses.whyCN: draft beer 字面上就是从桶里经龙头“拉”出来的啤酒，因此“从容器里抽出之物”这个古老义项活在这个日常短语里。

senses.title: A written order to pay
senses.titleCN: 汇票：让银行把钱“划”过去
senses.definition: a written order directing one party, usually a bank, to pay money to another
senses.definitionCN: 指示一方（通常是银行）向另一方付款的书面命令
senses.example: The buyer paid with a bank draft rather than a personal cheque.
senses.exampleCN: 买方用银行汇票而非个人支票付款。
senses.why: A draft 'draws' money from one account and directs it to another. The document is the instrument of that pull, so the financial sense is a metaphor of drawing.
senses.whyCN: draft 把一笔钱从一个账户“拉”出来，再指向另一个账户。这张单据就是那次抽取的工具，所以财务义仍是“拉”的隐喻。

senses.title: Compose a document
senses.titleCN: 起草：把文字拉到成型
senses.definition: to write the first version of a document, speech, law, or plan
senses.definitionCN: 写出文件、演讲、法律或方案的第一版
senses.example: A small team was asked to draft the new constitution.
senses.exampleCN: 一个小团队受命起草新宪法。
senses.why: The verb is the act behind the noun: you pull words into sentences and sentences into a document. What you produce is still a draft, not a final text.
senses.whyCN: 动词是名词背后的动作：把词拉成句子，把句子拉成文件。产出的仍是 draft，而不是定稿。

senses.title: An animal that pulls loads
senses.titleCN: 役用牲畜：专门用来拉东西
senses.definition: an animal bred or used for pulling heavy loads, such as a plough or a cart
senses.definitionCN: 为拉重物（如犁或车）而饲养或使用的牲畜
senses.example: Before tractors, a pair of draft horses did most of the field work.
senses.exampleCN: 在拖拉机之前，一对役用马承担了大部分田间劳作。
senses.why: This sense keeps the oldest meaning of dragan, 'to draw, drag'. A draft horse is quite literally a drawing horse, an animal whose job is to pull.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项保留着 dragan 最古老的意思“拉、拖”。draft horse 字面上就是“拉车的马”，它的工作就是拽。

senses.title: Depth of water a ship needs
senses.titleCN: 吃水：船体吃进水里的深度
senses.definition: the depth of water a loaded ship needs in order to float
senses.definitionCN: 满载船只需要的水深，才能浮起来
senses.example: The harbour is too shallow for ships of that draft.
senses.exampleCN: 这个港口太浅，容不下吃水那么深的船。
senses.why: A ship 'draws' water as its hull pushes down into it; the depth it draws is its draft. Here the old verb is still visible in the physical sense 'pull down into'.
senses.whyCN: 船体压入水中时“拉”起水来；它拉下的深度就是吃水。这里古动词仍以“向下拉入”的物理义留在词里。

intro.en: Draft and draught are the same word in two spellings. Both go back to the Old English verb dragan 'to draw, drag', whose basic picture — pulling something out or along — explains every sense from a sketch to a current of air.
intro.cn: draft 与 draught 是同一个词的两种拼法，都可追溯到古英语动词 dragan“拉、拖”。它的基本画面——把东西拉出来或拉着走——解释了从草图到气流的所有义项。

items.en: Dragan meant 'to draw, drag, pull'. It is a strong Germanic verb, related to English drag and draw themselves.
items.cn: dragan 意为“拉、拖、拽”。它是一个强变化日耳曼动词，与英语的 drag、draw 同源。

items.en: By the Middle English period the noun draught meant 'the act of drawing' and also 'that which is drawn': a load, a catch of fish, a gulp of liquid.
items.cn: 到中古英语时期，名词 draught 既指“拉的动作”，也指“被拉出来的东西”：一车负载、一网鱼、一口液体。

items.en: The spelling draft appears as a variant of draught. Over time British English kept draught for air, beer, and ships, while American English generalized draft to almost every sense.
items.cn: 拼写 draft 作为 draught 的变体出现。后来英式英语在空气、啤酒、船只等义上保留 draught，而美式英语几乎把所有义项都统一成 draft。

items.en: The sense 'selection of men for military service' develops from the idea of drawing men out of the population. The word then also names the body of men so drawn.
items.cn: “挑选男子服役”这个义项从“把男子从人口中抽出来”的观念发展而来。随后这个词也指被这样抽出的一批人。

items.en: In the 19th century American sport borrowed the same image for the player draft, and commerce extended it to a bank draft, an order that draws money from an account.
items.cn: 19 世纪美国体育借用了同一意象，指球员选秀；商业则把它扩展到 bank draft，即从账户中“抽取”款项的指令。

items.en: Today draft covers writing, planning, sport, conscription, air, beer, banking, and the depth of a hull. The unity is easy to miss but never absent: something is being drawn out or pulled into shape.
items.cn: 今天的 draft 覆盖写作、规划、体育、征兵、空气、啤酒、银行与船体吃水。这种统一性容易看不见，却从未消失：总有东西被拉出来，或被拉成一个形状。

note.en: The first group contains the same word in another spelling and its derivatives; the second collects words for first versions and for selecting people.
note.cn: 第一组是同一个词的另一种拼法及其派生词；第二组收“初版”和“挑人”两类近义词。

entries.definition: the British spelling of draft, especially for air, beer, and the depth of a ship. It is not a different word.
entries.definitionCN: draft 的英式拼法，尤用于空气、啤酒和船只吃水。它不是另一个词。

entries.definition: a person who writes the first version of a document. Draft + -er.
entries.definitionCN: 撰写文件初稿的人。draft + -er。

entries.definition: a person who makes technical drawings, or who drafts documents. Also spelled draughtsman.
entries.definitionCN: 绘制技术图样或起草文件的人。也拼作 draughtsman。

entries.definition: an amount drawn from a bank account beyond the money in it. Over- + draft.
entries.definitionCN: 从银行账户中超出余额支取的钱。over- + draft。

entries.definition: a summary that shows the main points without detail. A draft is fuller and closer to a finished text.
entries.definitionCN: 只列要点、不含细节的概要。draft 更完整，更接近成稿。

entries.definition: one form of something that may be changed later. A draft is specifically the first working version.
entries.definitionCN: 某物可能再改的一种形态。draft 特指第一个工作版本。

entries.definition: compulsory enlistment for military service. It is the formal synonym of draft in that sense.
entries.definitionCN: 强制入伍服役。它是 draft 征兵义的正式同义词。

entries.definition: to raise soldiers or money by authority. It stresses the official imposition more than the drawing out.
entries.definitionCN: 凭权力征集士兵或钱款。它更强调官方强制，而非“抽取”。

normalIntro.en: Real parts and relatives: Old English dragan 'draw', the double spelling draft/draught, and the family drafter, draftsman, overdraft, drafty.
normalIntro.cn: 只用真实成分与同族词：古英语 dragan“拉”、draft/draught 两种拼法，以及 drafter、draftsman、overdraft、drafty 词族。

normal.en: Everything drafted is drawn: a text is drawn into shape, soldiers are drawn from a crowd, beer is drawn from a barrel.
normal.cn: 所有 draft 都含着“拉”：文字被拉成形，士兵被从人群里抽出，啤酒被从桶里拉出来。

normal.en: Draft and draught are one word. British air, beer, and ships use draught; American English says draft almost everywhere.
normal.cn: draft 与 draught 是一个词。英式在空气、啤酒、船只上用 draught；美式几乎处处用 draft。

normal.en: A draft is not a failure; it is a shape made on purpose so that it can be changed.
normal.cn: draft 不是失败，而是特意做成、好让你能改的形状。

normal.en: The sports draft and the army draft share one sentence: somebody is drawn out of the pool.
normal.cn: 体育选秀与军队征兵共享一句话：有人被从池子里抽出来。

normal.en: A draft horse is a drawing horse; its whole job is to pull.
normal.cn: draft horse 就是“拉车的马”，它全部的工作就是拽。

abstract.en: A first draft is a promise written in pencil, not a verdict written in stone.
abstract.cn: 初稿是用铅笔写下的承诺，不是用石头刻下的判决。

abstract.en: To draft is to choose which parts of a cloud to pull into a line.
abstract.cn: 起草，就是从一团云里挑出一些部分，把它们拉成一条线。

abstract.en: Every finished work is a draft that someone finally stopped pulling.
abstract.cn: 每一件完成的作品，都是一份有人终于停止拉扯的草稿。

examples.en: She drafted the email three times before she dared to send it.
examples.cn: 她把这封邮件改了三稿才敢发出去。

examples.en: The country abolished the military draft in the early 1970s.
examples.cn: 该国在 1970 年代初废除了兵役征召。

examples.en: Cold air came through a draft under the old wooden door.
examples.cn: 冷空气从旧木门底下的缝隙灌进来。

dict_mnemonic.text: “抓夫特”——抓夫特把壮丁从人群里一把拉出来 → draft 征兵、草稿（拉出来的初形）

root: 源自古英语 dragan“拉、拖”，名词 draught 指“拉的动作或被拉出之物”；核心是“把东西从原处拉出来，拉成一个初步形状”。

sensesIntro.en: Ten senses of draft, all versions of one action: something is drawn out of a larger mass or pulled into a first shape.
sensesIntro.cn: draft 的十个义项都是同一个动作的不同版本：某物被从更大的整体中拉出来，或被拉成一个初步形状。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand pulling something out of a mass and giving it a first shape.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手把某物从一团东西里拉出来，并给它一个初步形状。

chain: PULL WORDS INTO A FIRST VERSION
PULL LIQUID OR AIR FROM A SOURCE
PULL A LOAD OR A DEPTH

branches.en: MAKING: writing, drawing, and composing all pull an unreal thing into a first visible form.
branches.cn: 制作：写作、绘图、起草，都是把尚未成形的东西拉成第一个可见形态。

branches.en: SELECTION: an army and a sports team both draw a few people out of a larger pool.
branches.cn: 挑选：军队与球队都从更大的池子里抽出少数人。

branches.en: DRAWING OFF: air through a gap, beer through a tap, water under a hull — the same pull through an opening.
branches.cn: 抽取：空气过缝隙、啤酒过龙头、水托船体——都是穿过一个开口的拉拽。

branches.en: FINANCE: a bank draft draws money out of an account and sends it elsewhere.
branches.cn: 金融：银行汇票把钱从账户里抽出来，送到别处。

branches.en: LABOUR: a draft animal is the oldest and most literal version — a body kept for pulling.
branches.cn: 劳作：役用牲畜是最古老、最字面的版本——一个专门用来拉东西的身体。

intro.en: Draft is a Germanic word, so its family is built with English suffixes and prefixes rather than Latin ones. The core sense 'draw, pull' stays visible throughout.
intro.cn: draft 是日耳曼词，所以它的词族由英语后缀和前缀构成，而不是拉丁语缀。核心义“拉、抽”贯穿始终。

latinIntro.en: Draft has no Latin root: it descends from the Old English strong verb dragan. LatinEntries is therefore left empty rather than inventing a classical source.
latinIntro.cn: draft 没有拉丁词根：它来自古英语强动词 dragan。因此 latinEntries 留空，不编造古典来源。

items.meaning: one who writes a first version
items.meaningCN: 起草人（-er 构成施事名词）
items.example: The drafter left notes in the margin for the editor.
items.exampleCN: 起草人在页边给编辑留了注。

items.meaning: a maker of technical drawings or documents
items.meaningCN: 技术制图员或文书起草者（-sman 构成职业名词）
items.example: A skilled draftsman turned the sketch into buildable plans.
items.exampleCN: 一位熟练的制图员把草图变成了可施工的图纸。

items.meaning: full of cold air currents; poorly sealed
items.meaningCN: 漏风的；有穿堂风的（-y 构成形容词）
items.example: The old farmhouse was charming but drafty in winter.
items.exampleCN: 那座老农舍很有味道，但冬天漏风。

items.meaning: to write a new version of a text or plan
items.meaningCN: 重新起草；改写（re- 表示“再次”）
items.example: The committee had to redraft the policy after the consultation.
items.exampleCN: 咨询之后，委员会不得不重新起草政策。

items.meaning: money drawn beyond the balance of an account
items.meaningCN: 透支额；超出账户余额支取的钱（over- 表示“超出”）
items.example: The account carries a small overdraft at the end of each month.
items.exampleCN: 这个账户每月末都有一点透支。

items.meaning: a rising current of air
items.meaningCN: 上升气流（up- 表示“向上”）
items.example: Gliders circle inside a strong updraft to gain height.
items.exampleCN: 滑翔机在强上升气流里盘旋以获得高度。

items.meaning: a downward current of air
items.meaningCN: 下沉气流（down- 表示“向下”）
items.example: A sudden downdraft pushed the plane toward the runway.
items.exampleCN: 一股突然的下沉气流把飞机压向跑道。

items.meaning: the right to select a player, or the player selected
items.meaningCN: 选秀权；被选中的球员（复合名词）
items.example: They traded two veterans for a top draft pick.
items.exampleCN: 他们用两名老将换来了一个高顺位选秀权。

items.meaning: air current, beer from a tap, or depth of a hull
items.meaningCN: 气流、扎啤或船体吃水（英式拼法）
items.example: The pub serves draught cider from a local orchard.
items.exampleCN: 这家酒馆供应本地果园的散装苹果酒。

items.meaning: a person who avoids compulsory military service
items.meaningCN: 逃避兵役者（复合名词）
items.example: During the war, draft dodgers often crossed into Canada.
items.exampleCN: 战争期间，逃避兵役者常常越境进入加拿大。

definition_zh: 有活力的；不断变化的；动态的；（物理）力与运动的
definition_en: full of energy and force, constantly changing, or relating to forces and motion
core_image: 一股从内部推出来的力，让静止的东西开始动，并且停不下来。
scene: The startup grew fast because its young team brought a dynamic energy to every meeting.
sceneCN: 这里 dynamic 是「充满推动力的、有活力的」（第 1 个义项：人的劲头）；句意：这家初创公司成长很快，因为年轻的团队给每次会议都带来了蓬勃的活力。场景要点：白板上密集的标记、抢着发言的人、快节奏的讨论。

pos.zh: 有活力的；动态的；力学的；不断变化的
动力；动态因素（常用复数 dynamics）

collocations.zh: 群体动力学；群体互动关系
动态范围（声音或图像的明暗／强弱跨度）

derivatives.zh: 动力学；（群体、局势的）动态关系

senses.title: Full of energy and force
senses.titleCN: 有劲头：一个人或风格带着推力
senses.definition: of a person, performance, or style, full of energy and able to drive others
senses.definitionCN: 指人、表演或风格充满能量，能带动别人
senses.example: She gave a dynamic presentation that woke up the whole room.
senses.exampleCN: 她做了一场充满劲头的报告，把整个房间都唤醒了。
senses.why: Greek dynamis meant 'power, strength'. A dynamic person is literally one with power in them — power that shows as movement, voice, and pace.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 dynamis 意为“力量、能力”。a dynamic person 字面上就是身上有力量的人，这力量表现为动作、声音和节奏。

senses.title: Constantly changing
senses.titleCN: 不断变化：没有一刻停在原地
senses.definition: changing actively and continuously rather than staying fixed
senses.definitionCN: 活跃而持续地变化，而不是固定不变
senses.example: Housing prices in a dynamic market can shift within a single month.
senses.exampleCN: 在动态的市场里，房价可能一个月内就变。
senses.why: Power that is present does not sit still; it produces motion. A dynamic market or society is one whose parts keep moving, so no snapshot stays true for long.
senses.whyCN: 力量在场就不会静止，它会制造运动。动态的市场或社会，就是各部分一直在动，所以任何一个快照都很快过时。

senses.title: Relating to force and motion (physics)
senses.titleCN: 物理上的力学：研究力如何产生运动
senses.definition: relating to forces that produce motion, or to the branch of mechanics that studies them
senses.definitionCN: 与产生运动的力有关，或与研究这些力的力学分支有关
senses.example: The engineer modelled the dynamic loads on the bridge during an earthquake.
senses.exampleCN: 工程师模拟了地震时桥上的动态载荷。
senses.why: This is the word's technical home. Dynamics is the study of bodies in motion and the forces that move them, as opposed to statics, the study of bodies at rest.
senses.whyCN: 这是这个词的技术本家。dynamics 研究运动中的物体以及推动它们的力，与研究静止物体的 statics 相对。

senses.title: Interactive and self-adjusting (systems)
senses.titleCN: 系统能自我调整：输入一变，内部就重排
senses.definition: of a system, able to change its state or behaviour in response to input
senses.definitionCN: 指系统能根据输入改变自身状态或行为
senses.example: A dynamic system can recover after a disturbance without outside help.
senses.exampleCN: 动态系统能在受扰动后自行恢复，不需外力。
senses.why: In physics and systems theory, dynamic describes a system whose variables evolve over time. The opposite is static, a system frozen into one configuration.
senses.whyCN: 在物理与系统论中，dynamic 描述变量随时间演化的系统。反义词是 static，即被冻结在一种配置里的系统。

senses.title: Variation in loudness (music)
senses.titleCN: 音乐的力度变化：强弱起伏
senses.definition: the pattern of changes in volume or intensity in a piece of music
senses.definitionCN: 一段音乐中音量或强度的变化模式
senses.example: The conductor shaped the dynamics so that the ending felt almost silent.
senses.exampleCN: 指挥精心处理力度变化，让结尾几乎听不见。
senses.why: Music moves the listener by moving its volume. The plural noun dynamics names those changes, treating loudness as a force that rises and falls.
senses.whyCN: 音乐靠音量的运动打动人。复数名词 dynamics 命名这些变化，把响度当成一股可升可降的力。

senses.title: The forces inside a situation
senses.titleCN: 局势内部的动力关系：谁推谁、谁牵制谁
senses.definition: the patterns of interaction and influence among people or groups
senses.definitionCN: 人或群体之间互动与影响的模式
senses.example: Before proposing a fix, study the dynamics of the family.
senses.exampleCN: 提出解决办法之前，先研究这个家庭的动力关系。
senses.why: A situation is not a list of parts but a field of pushes and pulls. Dynamics names those invisible forces, borrowed from mechanics into psychology and politics.
senses.whyCN: 一个局面不是零件的清单，而是一片推与拉的场。dynamics 命名这些看不见的力，这个词从力学借进了心理学和政治学。

senses.title: An action verb (grammar)
senses.titleCN: 语法中的动态动词：表示动作而非状态
senses.definition: of a verb, describing an action or event rather than a state
senses.definitionCN: 指动词表示动作或事件，而不是状态
senses.example: Run and build are dynamic verbs; know and belong are stative.
senses.exampleCN: run 和 build 是动态动词；know 和 belong 是状态动词。
senses.why: Grammarians borrowed the physics contrast: a dynamic verb reports movement or change, while a stative verb reports a condition that simply holds.
senses.whyCN: 语法学家借用了物理学的对立：动态动词报告运动或变化，状态动词报告一个仅仅持续着的状况。

senses.title: Generated while running (computing)
senses.titleCN: 程序运行时才生成：内容与内存可随时变
senses.definition: of web content or memory, created or allocated while a program is running rather than fixed in advance
senses.definitionCN: 指网页内容或内存是在程序运行时创建或分配的，而非预先固定
senses.example: The page loads dynamic content based on what you have clicked.
senses.exampleCN: 这个页面根据你点过的东西加载动态内容。
senses.why: Software repeats the old contrast: a static page is a printed sheet, a dynamic one is assembled on the spot. What is dynamic is produced by the running system itself.
senses.whyCN: 软件重复着那组古老对立：静态页面像印好的纸，动态页面是现场拼装的。dynamic 的东西由运行中的系统自己生产。

senses.title: Stable while still moving
senses.titleCN: 动态平衡：整体稳，内部一直在动
senses.definition: a state of balance maintained by continuous adjustment rather than by standing still
senses.definitionCN: 靠持续调整维持的平衡，而不是靠静止不动
senses.example: A cyclist stays upright through dynamic equilibrium, not by freezing.
senses.exampleCN: 骑车人靠动态平衡保持直立，而不是靠冻住不动。
senses.why: This is the subtlest sense: balance is not the absence of motion but motion that keeps correcting itself. The system looks still only because its parts are busy.
senses.whyCN: 这是最精微的义项：平衡不是没有运动，而是不断自我纠正的运动。系统看起来静止，只因为它的零件正忙。

intro.en: Dynamic comes from Greek dynamis, 'power, strength, ability'. English first used it for physical force, then extended it to anything that keeps changing and driving forward.
intro.cn: dynamic 来自希腊语 dynamis“力量、能力”。英语先把它用于物理上的力，再扩展到一切不断变化、不断向前推动的东西。

items.en: Dynamis meant 'power, strength, ability, capacity to act'. It is the noun behind the whole family, including dynamo and dynamite.
items.cn: dynamis 意为“力量、能力、行动的能力”。它是整个词族的名词根，包括 dynamo 与 dynamite。

items.en: The verb dynasthai meant 'to be able, to have power'. Its deeper origin is uncertain; dictionaries generally treat it as a Greek formation without a secure outside match.
items.cn: 动词 dynasthai 意为“能够、拥有力量”。它更深的来源不确定；词典一般把它当作希腊语内部构成，没有可靠的外部对应。

items.en: The adjective dynamikos meant 'powerful, able'. English dynamic is borrowed from this adjective through Latin and French learned usage.
items.cn: 形容词 dynamikos 意为“有力量的、有能力的”。英语 dynamic 经拉丁语与法语的学术用法借自这个形容词。

items.en: Dynamics, the study of forces and motion, developed in the 17th century. The adjective dynamic entered English in the early 19th century in mechanics.
items.cn: dynamics（研究力与运动的学科）在 17 世纪发展起来。形容词 dynamic 于 19 世纪初以力学用语进入英语。

items.en: From physics the word moved to music (dynamics of volume), psychology (group dynamics), economics, grammar, and computing.
items.cn: 从物理学，这个词走向音乐（音量的 dynamics）、心理学（群体动力学）、经济学、语法和计算机。

items.en: Today dynamic is the default adjective for anything that is energetic, adaptive, or continuously changing, while its opposite static names anything fixed.
items.cn: 今天 dynamic 是“有活力、能适应、持续变化”之物的默认形容词，而它的反义词 static 命名一切固定之物。

note.en: The first group shares the Greek dynamis root, including the surprising relative dynasty; the second collects words for energy and change.
note.cn: 第一组共享希腊语 dynamis 词根，其中包括看似意外的亲戚 dynasty；第二组收“能量”与“变化”类近义词。

entries.definition: a machine that turns motion into electricity; informally, a very energetic person. It is a shortening of dynamo-electric machine, built on Greek dynamis.
entries.definitionCN: 把运动转化为电的机器；口语中也指精力极旺的人。它是 dynamo-electric machine 的缩略，建立在希腊语 dynamis 上。

entries.definition: an explosive invented by Alfred Nobel, named from Greek dynamis 'power' plus the chemical suffix -ite.
entries.definitionCN: 阿尔弗雷德·诺贝尔发明的炸药，由希腊语 dynamis“力量”加化学后缀 -ite 命名。

entries.definition: a line of rulers from one family. It comes from Greek dynasteia 'power, lordship', from dynasthai 'to have power' — the same root as dynamic.
entries.definitionCN: 同一家族延续的统治者。它来自希腊语 dynasteia“权力、统治”，再上溯 dynasthai“拥有力量”——与 dynamic 同根。

entries.definition: the branch of mechanics that studies forces and motion; also the pattern of forces in a group or situation.
entries.definitionCN: 研究力与运动的力学分支；也指群体或局势中的力量格局。

entries.definition: full of physical or mental energy. It describes a person's supply of drive; dynamic adds the effect that drive has on others.
entries.definitionCN: 体力或精力充沛的。它描述一个人拥有的劲头；dynamic 还多一层“这股劲能带动别人”的效果。

entries.definition: doing things rather than resting. It is broader and can be neutral; dynamic usually implies force and change.
entries.definitionCN: 做事而非休息的。它更宽，也可中性；dynamic 通常含力量与变化。

entries.definition: not fixed; able to move and change shape. It stresses smooth adaptability, while dynamic stresses driving force.
entries.definitionCN: 不固定的；能流动变形的。它强调顺畅的适应性，dynamic 强调推动力。

entries.definition: relating to motion. It is a technical cousin from Greek kinesis 'movement', not from dynamis, and is narrower than dynamic.
entries.definitionCN: 与运动有关的。它是来自希腊语 kinesis“运动”的技术表亲，并非来自 dynamis，范围比 dynamic 窄。

normalIntro.en: Real parts and relatives: Greek dynamis 'power', the family dynamo, dynamite, dynasty, dynamics, and the physics contrast dynamic/static.
normalIntro.cn: 只用真实成分与同族词：希腊语 dynamis“力量”，以及 dynamo、dynamite、dynasty、dynamics 词族，和 dynamic/static 的物理对立。

normal.en: Dynamic is built on dynamis 'power': a dynamic person is one with power that shows.
normal.cn: dynamic 建立在 dynamis“力量”上：有 dynamic 的人，就是身上有力量并且看得见的人。

normal.en: The same root gives dynamite and dynamo — both are literally 'power' devices.
normal.cn: 同一个词根给出 dynamite 与 dynamo——两者字面上都是“力量”装置。

normal.en: Dynasty looks unrelated but is the same family: power held by a line of rulers.
normal.cn: dynasty 看起来无关，其实是同族：由一脉统治者掌握的权。

normal.en: In physics the pair is dynamic/static: moving versus standing still.
normal.cn: 物理里的成对词是 dynamic/static：运动对静止。

normal.en: Dynamic equilibrium is a cyclist, not a parked bike: balance made by constant small corrections.
normal.cn: 动态平衡是骑车的人，不是停着的车：平衡靠不断的小修正维持。

abstract.en: A dynamic thing is not a photograph; it is a film that refuses to stop.
abstract.cn: 有动态的东西不是一张照片，而是一部不肯停的电影。

abstract.en: Energy is visible only where something is being moved against resistance.
abstract.cn: 能量只在某物顶着阻力被移动的地方才看得见。

abstract.en: Change is stable only when it keeps correcting itself.
abstract.cn: 变化之所以能稳定，只因为它一直在自我纠正。

examples.en: The city has a dynamic cultural scene that changes every season.
examples.cn: 这座城市的文化场景很有活力，每一季都在变。

examples.en: Scientists measured the dynamic response of the material to stress.
examples.cn: 科学家测量了材料受力时的动态响应。

examples.en: Good managers understand the dynamics of a team before changing its structure.
examples.cn: 好的管理者在改变团队结构前，先理解团队的动态关系。

dict_mnemonic.text: “大拿米克”——大拿米克一进场就带着一股推力，全场都动起来 → dynamic 有活力的、动态的

root: 源自希腊语 dynamis“力量、能力”，经 dynamikos“有力量的”进入学术拉丁语与法语；核心是“内部有力量，因而持续运动、不断推动”。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses of dynamic, all traced to one idea: power that is actually at work, so things move and keep changing.
sensesIntro.cn: dynamic 的九个义项都追溯到一个观念：真正在起作用的力量，因此事物会动，并且持续变化。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a force pushing outward from inside, setting a still thing into motion.
core.cn: 核心意象：一股从内部向外推的力，让静止之物开始运动。

branches.en: PERSONAL FORCE: a dynamic speaker or leader carries power that moves other people.
branches.cn: 人的力量：有 dynamic 的演讲者或领导者，带着能推动他人的力量。

branches.en: LIVE CHANGE: a market and a web page are both assembled as they run, never fixed in advance.
branches.cn: 实时变化：市场与网页都是边运行边拼装，从不预先固定。

branches.en: MECHANICS: force produces motion, and balance is motion that corrects itself.
branches.cn: 力学：力产生运动，而平衡就是自我纠正的运动。

branches.en: SYSTEMS: a system and a family both evolve through internal pushes and pulls.
branches.cn: 系统：一个系统与一个家庭，都通过内部的推拉而演化。

branches.en: BORROWED CONTRASTS: music rises and falls in volume; grammar separates action from state.
branches.cn: 借来的对立：音乐音量有起伏；语法把动作与状态分开。

intro.en: Dynamic is Greek in origin. The productive element is dynam-, 'power'; suffixes build the noun dynamics, the adjective dynamical, and the person or thing nouns dynamo and dynamism.
intro.cn: dynamic 源自希腊语。能产要素是 dynam-“力量”；后缀构成名词 dynamics、形容词 dynamical，以及表人或物的 dynamo 与 dynamism。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root behind dynamic: the chain is Greek dynamis and dynamikos, borrowed into scientific Latin. LatinEntries is left empty rather than forcing a Latin form.
latinIntro.cn: dynamic 背后没有拉丁词根：链条是希腊语 dynamis 与 dynamikos，被借入科学拉丁语。因此 latinEntries 留空，不硬造拉丁形式。

items.meaning: the science of forces and motion; the forces at work in a situation
items.meaningCN: 研究力与运动的学科；局势中起作用的力量（-s 构成学科名词）
items.example: Classical dynamics explains how a thrown ball curves.
items.exampleCN: 经典动力学解释抛出的球为何走弧线。

items.meaning: relating to dynamics or to change over time
items.meaningCN: 与动力学或随时间变化有关的（-al 构成形容词）
items.example: The model uses dynamical equations rather than a fixed table.
items.exampleCN: 该模型使用动力学方程，而不是固定表格。

items.meaning: in a way that changes or responds as conditions change
items.meaningCN: 以动态响应条件变化的方式（-ly 构成副词）
items.example: The page updates its chart dynamically as new data arrives.
items.exampleCN: 新数据到达时，页面会动态更新图表。

items.meaning: vigorous energy or the quality of being dynamic
items.meaningCN: 旺盛的活力；动态性质（-ism 构成抽象名词）
items.example: The city's dynamism attracted artists from everywhere.
items.exampleCN: 这座城市的活力吸引了各地艺术家。

items.meaning: a generator; informally, an energetic person
items.meaningCN: 发电机；口语中指精力旺盛的人
items.example: The old bicycle dynamo lit the front lamp.
items.exampleCN: 旧的自行车发电机点亮了前灯。

items.meaning: a high explosive; informally, something powerful or exciting
items.meaningCN: 烈性炸药；口语中指极有力或极刺激的事物
items.example: Nobel named his explosive after the Greek word for power.
items.exampleCN: 诺贝尔用希腊语“力量”一词给他的炸药命名。

items.meaning: a line of rulers from the same family
items.meaningCN: 同一家族延续的统治王朝
items.example: The Ming dynasty ruled for nearly three centuries.
items.exampleCN: 明朝统治了近三个世纪。

items.meaning: the study of fluids in motion
items.meaningCN: 流体动力学（hydro- 表示“水”）
items.example: Ship design relies on hydrodynamics.
items.exampleCN: 船舶设计依赖流体动力学。

items.meaning: the study of heat, work, and energy
items.meaningCN: 热力学（thermo- 表示“热”）
items.example: The second law of thermodynamics limits engine efficiency.
items.exampleCN: 热力学第二定律限制发动机效率。

items.meaning: relating to the forces of air moving around a body
items.meaningCN: 空气动力学的；与空气绕物体流动的力有关的（aero- 表示“空气”）
items.example: The new wing is more aerodynamic than the old one.
items.exampleCN: 新机翼比旧机翼更具空气动力性。

definition_zh: 经济；经济体；节约；经济舱；（某种活动的）运作体系
definition_en: the system by which a country or region produces and uses goods and money, careful use of resources, or a cheap class of travel
core_image: 一个管家在屋里分配有限的粮食：谁先吃、吃多少、怎样不浪费。
scene: The household budget taught him the same lesson as the national economy: spend less than you earn.
sceneCN: 这里 economy 先后指「国家经济体」与「节约」两个层面（第 1、2 个义项）；句意：家庭预算教给他的道理和国家经济一样：花得要比挣得少。场景要点：账本、收据、餐桌上按份分配的菜。

pos.zh: 经济；经济体；节约；经济舱；（活动的）运作体系

collocations.zh: 看似省钱实则更费钱的做法

senses.title: A country's system of production and money
senses.titleCN: 国家经济体：生产、流通、消费的总体
senses.definition: the system by which a country or region produces, distributes, and consumes goods and services
senses.definitionCN: 一个国家或地区生产、分配、消费商品与服务的体系
senses.example: Tourism now accounts for a fifth of the island's economy.
senses.exampleCN: 旅游业现在占这座岛经济总量的五分之一。
senses.why: Greek oikonomia meant managing a household's resources. A national economy is that same task scaled up: a huge household with many members and one budget.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 oikonomia 意为管理一家人的资源。国家经济体就是把同一件事放大：一个成员众多、只有一本账的大家庭。

senses.title: Thrift and careful use
senses.titleCN: 节约：少浪费，把资源用在该用的地方
senses.definition: careful management of money, fuel, or other resources so that nothing is wasted
senses.definitionCN: 谨慎管理金钱、燃料等资源，避免浪费
senses.example: The new engine offers better fuel economy on long trips.
senses.exampleCN: 新发动机在长途行驶时更省油。
senses.why: The household manager's first duty is not to waste. Economy as thrift is the original domestic virtue, still visible in 'economy car' and 'fuel economy'.
senses.whyCN: 管家的第一职责是不浪费。作为节约的 economy 是最原始的家政美德，仍活在 economy car 与 fuel economy 里。

senses.title: The cheapest travel class
senses.titleCN: 经济舱：用更少的钱坐同一架飞机
senses.definition: the cheapest class of seating on a plane or train
senses.definitionCN: 飞机或火车上最便宜的座位等级
senses.example: We flew economy and used the savings on the hotel.
senses.exampleCN: 我们坐经济舱，把省下的钱用在酒店上。
senses.why: The class is named after thrift: you accept less space to spend less. Economy here is an adjective-like label for the frugal option.
senses.whyCN: 这个舱位以“节约”命名：你接受更少的空间，以花更少的钱。这里的 economy 是给“省钱选项”贴的标签。

senses.title: Savings from larger scale
senses.titleCN: 规模经济：做得越多，单位成本越低
senses.definition: the cost advantage that comes from producing or buying in larger quantities
senses.definitionCN: 因生产或购买数量更大而获得的成本优势
senses.example: The factory achieved economies of scale by doubling its output.
senses.exampleCN: 工厂把产量翻倍，实现了规模经济。
senses.why: A household that buys rice by the sack spends less per bowl than one that buys by the cup. Economy of scale is that household logic applied to industry.
senses.whyCN: 按袋买米的家庭，每碗饭的成本低于按杯买米的家庭。规模经济就是把这条家庭逻辑用到工业上。

senses.title: Economy of words or effort
senses.titleCN: 言辞或力气的节省：用最少的手段达到目的
senses.definition: the quality of using no more words, motion, or material than necessary
senses.definitionCN: 不多用一个词、一个动作、一份材料就能达到目的
senses.example: Her essay is admired for its economy of expression.
senses.exampleCN: 她的文章因表达精练而受赞赏。
senses.why: This is thrift applied to language and movement. Economy of expression is not stinginess but the removal of everything that does not do work.
senses.whyCN: 这是把节约用在语言和动作上。表达的 economy 不是吝啬，而是删掉一切不干活的东西。

senses.title: A market-based system
senses.titleCN: 市场经济：由价格和交易组织生产
senses.definition: an economic system in which prices, investment, and production are shaped mainly by private exchange
senses.definitionCN: 价格、投资与生产主要由私人交易决定的经济制度
senses.example: The country moved from a planned economy to a market economy.
senses.exampleCN: 该国从计划经济转向市场经济。
senses.why: Economy here names a type, not a size. The household is replaced by millions of separate households trading, and the market does the managing.
senses.whyCN: 这里的 economy 命名一种类型，而不是规模。家庭被千百万个互相交易的家庭取代，由市场来做那个“管家”。

senses.title: A new sector's way of working
senses.titleCN: 某种活动的运作体系：注意力经济、共享经济
senses.definition: the way a particular field produces and distributes value, often used in phrases like 'the attention economy'
senses.definitionCN: 某个特定领域生产与分配价值的方式，常用于 the attention economy 等说法
senses.example: Social platforms are central to the attention economy.
senses.exampleCN: 社交平台处于注意力经济的中心。
senses.why: The word has been extended from money to any scarce resource that is managed: attention, data, reputation, care. Each field has its own household to run.
senses.whyCN: 这个词从金钱扩展到任何被管理的稀缺资源：注意力、数据、声誉、照护。每个领域都有自己那个要操持的“家”。

senses.title: A saving that costs more later
senses.titleCN: 假节约：省了小钱，赔了大钱
senses.definition: a decision that looks like a saving but leads to greater cost later
senses.definitionCN: 看起来省钱、日后却造成更大开销的决定
senses.example: Buying the cheapest tyres was a false economy; they wore out in a year.
senses.exampleCN: 买最便宜的轮胎是假节约，一年就磨坏了。
senses.why: Economy can be short-sighted. The phrase false economy marks the moment when the household manager saves a coin today and pays for a new roof tomorrow.
senses.whyCN: 节约也可能短视。false economy 标记的就是管家今天省下一枚硬币、明天却要付新屋顶的时刻。

senses.title: The whole system of a place or activity
senses.titleCN: 整体运作体系：一座城、一个生态的“经济”
senses.definition: the interconnected system through which a place, institution, or activity sustains itself
senses.definitionCN: 一个地方、机构或活动赖以自我维持的互联体系
senses.example: The coral reef has its own economy of light, food, and shelter.
senses.exampleCN: 珊瑚礁有自己由光、食物与栖所构成的“经济”。
senses.why: This broad use treats any self-sustaining system as a household: resources come in, are transformed, and are shared out. It is metaphor, but a disciplined one.
senses.whyCN: 这个宽泛用法把任何自我维持的系统都当成一个家庭：资源进来、被转化、再分配出去。这是隐喻，但是有纪律的隐喻。

intro.en: Economy began as a Greek word for running a household. The household grew into the state, and the word grew with it, keeping both the 'system' sense and the 'thrift' sense.
intro.cn: economy 最初是希腊语里“操持家务”的词。家庭扩大成国家，这个词也跟着长大，同时保留了“体系”与“节约”两层意思。

items.en: Oikos meant 'house, household, family property'. It is the first half of oikonomia and the reason economy still feels domestic at its core.
items.cn: oikos 意为“房子、家庭、家产”。它是 oikonomia 的前半，也是 economy 的核心至今仍带居家感的原因。

items.en: Nemein meant 'to manage, distribute, allot'. Oikonomia was the managing of the household's resources, not the house itself.
items.cn: nemein 意为“管理、分配、分派”。oikonomia 是管理家宅的资源，而不是家宅本身。

items.en: Oikonomia meant 'household management' and also 'thrift'. It passed through Latin oeconomia into French and then English.
items.cn: oikonomia 意为“家务管理”，也指“节俭”。它经拉丁语 oeconomia 进入法语，再进入英语。

items.en: English economy is recorded in the 16th century first for household management and thrift. The state-level sense developed later.
items.cn: 英语 economy 最早记录于 16 世纪，先指家务管理与节俭。国家层面的义项后来才发展出来。

items.en: As states began to measure trade and revenue, 'political economy' made the nation the new household. The modern sense 'a country's economic system' grew from this.
items.cn: 当国家开始统计贸易与税收，“政治经济学”把国家变成新的家庭。“一个国家的经济体系”这个现代义项由此生长出来。

items.en: Economy now names everything from a national system to a cheap airline seat to a style of concise writing. The domestic picture of scarce resources still holds them together.
items.cn: 今天的 economy 从国家体系一直命名到廉价机票和简洁文风。稀缺资源要被操持的那幅居家画面，仍把它们拢在一起。

note.en: The first group is the oikonomia family, where economic, economical, and economics must be kept apart; the second collects thrift and system words.
note.cn: 第一组是 oikonomia 词族，其中 economic、economical、economics 必须分清；第二组收“节约”与“体系”类近义词。

entries.definition: relating to the economy or to money and trade. It describes the system, not a person's habit of saving.
entries.definitionCN: 与经济或金钱贸易有关的。它描述体系，不描述一个人省钱的习惯。

entries.definition: using resources carefully; not wasteful. A car can be economical with fuel; an economic policy is about the whole system.
entries.definitionCN: 节约使用资源的；不浪费的。汽车可以省油（economical），经济政策（economic）则关乎整个体系。

entries.definition: the academic study of production, distribution, and consumption. It is the -ics name of the field, not a plural of economy.
entries.definitionCN: 研究生产、分配与消费的学科。它是该领域的 -ics 名称，不是 economy 的复数。

entries.definition: a person who studies or advises on the economy.
entries.definitionCN: 研究经济或为经济提供建议的人。

entries.definition: careful spending and avoidance of waste. It is close to the 'careful use' sense of economy but sounds more like a personal virtue.
entries.definitionCN: 谨慎花钱、避免浪费。它接近 economy 的“节约使用”义，但更像个人美德。

entries.definition: the quality of living without waste or luxury. It is more moral and more formal than economy.
entries.definitionCN: 不浪费、不奢侈地生活的品质。它比 economy 更道德化、更正式。

entries.definition: a set of connected parts working together. It is broader than economy and lacks the resource-management image.
entries.definitionCN: 一组相互连接、共同运作的部分。它比 economy 宽，缺少“资源管理”的意象。

entries.definition: money or resources kept rather than spent. Economy is the habit or policy; a saving is one concrete amount kept.
entries.definitionCN: 没有花掉而保留下的钱或资源。economy 是习惯或政策；a saving 是具体省下的一笔。

normalIntro.en: Real parts and relatives: Greek oikos 'house' + nemein 'manage', and the family economic, economical, economics, economist, economize.
normalIntro.cn: 只用真实成分与同族词：希腊语 oikos“家”+ nemein“管理”，以及 economic、economical、economics、economist、economize 词族。

normal.en: Economy is oikos + nemein: the managing of a house. A national economy is just a very large house.
normal.cn: economy 是 oikos + nemein：操持一个家。国家经济只是一个非常大的家。

normal.en: The same word means both 'the system' and 'not wasting'. A good household needs both.
normal.cn: 同一个词既指“体系”也指“不浪费”。一个好的家庭两样都需要。

normal.en: Economic is about the system; economical is about saving. Do not mix the two adjectives.
normal.cn: economic 说的是体系；economical 说的是节约。两个形容词别混。

normal.en: Economies of scale: the more rice you buy, the less each bowl costs.
normal.cn: 规模经济：米买得越多，每碗饭越便宜。

normal.en: A false economy is saving on tyres and paying for a crash.
normal.cn: 假节约就是在轮胎上省钱，然后为一场事故付账。

abstract.en: An economy is a household that has forgotten how many members it has.
abstract.cn: 一个经济体，是一个忘了自己有多少成员的家。

abstract.en: Thrift is not doing without; it is refusing to pay for what you do not use.
abstract.cn: 节约不是缺衣少食，而是拒绝为你用不上的东西付钱。

abstract.en: Every system is an economy of something scarce, even when the currency is attention.
abstract.cn: 每个体系都是某种稀缺之物的经济，哪怕那种货币是注意力。

examples.en: Small businesses are the backbone of the local economy.
examples.cn: 小企业是本地经济的支柱。

examples.en: The government urged households to practise economy during the drought.
examples.cn: 干旱期间政府敦促家庭节约用水。

examples.en: She writes with an economy that makes every sentence carry weight.
examples.cn: 她写作极为精练，每句话都有分量。

dict_mnemonic.text: “依靠糯米”——依靠糯米精打细算地管家，一粒都不浪费 → economy 经济、节约

root: 源自希腊语 oikonomia“家务管理”，由 oikos“家”+ nemein“管理、分配”构成；核心是“把有限的资源在一个家里分配好、不浪费”。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses of economy, all versions of one task: managing scarce resources inside a bounded household, whether that household is a family, a country, or a field of activity.
sensesIntro.cn: economy 的九个义项都是同一件事的不同版本：在一个有边界的“家”里管理稀缺资源——这个家可以是家庭、国家，或某个活动领域。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a steward dividing a limited store of grain among the members of a household.
core.cn: 核心意象：管家把有限的一仓粮食分给家里的成员。

chain: A WHOLE WAY OF SUSTAINING LIFE

branches.en: SYSTEMS: a country, a market system, and a coral reef are all households with inputs and outputs.
branches.cn: 体系：国家、市场制度与珊瑚礁，都是有投入与产出的“家”。

branches.en: THRIFT: careful use of fuel, words, or money — and the mistake of saving where it costs more.
branches.cn: 节约：省燃料、省文字、省钱——以及在该花钱处省钱的错误。

branches.en: CHEAP OPTION: economy class applies the thrift idea to a seat on a plane.
branches.cn: 廉价选项：经济舱把节约观念用到一个飞机座位上。

branches.en: SCALE: buying or making more lowers the cost of each unit, like buying rice by the sack.
branches.cn: 规模：多买或多做会降低单位成本，就像按袋买米。

branches.en: NEW CURRENCIES: attention, data, and care can each become the scarce resource of an economy.
branches.cn: 新货币：注意力、数据与照护，都可以成为某种经济的稀缺资源。

intro.en: Economy's family is unusually crowded, and the -ic/-ical pair is a common trap. The base econom- carries 'household management'; suffixes separate the system, the habit, the discipline, and the person.
intro.cn: economy 的词族异常拥挤，-ic/-ical 这对是常见陷阱。词基 econom- 携带“家务管理”；后缀把体系、习惯、学科与人分开。

latinIntro.en: Economy reaches English through Latin oeconomia, but the root itself is Greek. The Latin borrowed form is real, yet the semantic source is oikos + nemein, so latinEntries records the Greek-derived Latin noun rather than a native Latin root.
latinIntro.cn: economy 经拉丁语 oeconomia 进入英语，但词根本身是希腊语。拉丁借形确实存在，但语义源头是 oikos + nemein，因此 latinEntries 记录这个希腊来源的拉丁名词，而不是本土拉丁词根。

items.meaning: relating to the economy
items.meaningCN: 与经济体系有关的（-ic 构成关系形容词）
items.example: The country reported strong economic growth.
items.exampleCN: 该国报告了强劲的经济增长。

items.meaning: using resources without waste
items.meaningCN: 节约使用资源的（-ical 构成方式形容词）
items.example: A small car is more economical for city driving.
items.exampleCN: 小车在城市里开更省。

items.meaning: in a way that saves resources, or with respect to the economy
items.meaningCN: 节约地；在经济层面上（-ly 构成副词）
items.example: The plant now runs more economically than before.
items.exampleCN: 工厂现在比过去运转得更省。

items.meaning: the study of production, distribution, and consumption
items.meaningCN: 经济学（-s 构成学科名词）
items.example: She studied economics before entering politics.
items.exampleCN: 她从政前学的是经济学。

items.meaning: a specialist in economics
items.meaningCN: 经济学家（-ist 构成人称名词）
items.example: Most economists expect slower growth next year.
items.exampleCN: 多数经济学家预计明年增长放缓。

items.meaning: to reduce spending or use less of something
items.meaningCN: 节省；紧缩开支（-ize 构成动词）
items.example: Families economized by cutting holidays and eating at home.
items.exampleCN: 家庭通过取消度假和在家吃饭来节省。

items.meaning: relating to the economy as a whole
items.meaningCN: 宏观经济的（macro- 表示“大、整体”）
items.example: Macroeconomic policy deals with inflation and employment.
items.exampleCN: 宏观经济政策处理通胀与就业。

items.meaning: relating to individual firms and households
items.meaningCN: 微观经济的（micro- 表示“小、个体”）
items.example: Microeconomic models study how one household chooses.
items.exampleCN: 微观经济模型研究一个家庭如何做选择。

items.meaning: the study of how politics and economic systems interact
items.meaningCN: 政治经济学；研究政治与经济体系如何相互作用
items.example: Classical political economy arose in the 18th century.
items.exampleCN: 古典政治经济学兴起于 18 世纪。

items.meaning: the statistical analysis of economic data
items.meaningCN: 计量经济学；对经济数据的统计分析
items.example: Econometrics turns price data into testable models.
items.exampleCN: 计量经济学把价格数据变成可检验的模型。

definition_zh: 编辑；校订；剪辑；删改；主编；编辑版本
definition_en: to revise and improve a text, prepare it for publication, cut or rearrange material, or change digital content
core_image: 一双手在稿纸上删、改、挪：把多余的部分剪掉，让留下的部分更清楚。
scene: The editor spent the morning editing a long paragraph down to three clear sentences.
sceneCN: 这里 edit 是「删改文字、让表达更清楚」（第 1 个义项：修订文稿）；句意：编辑花了一上午，把一段长文字改成了三个清楚的句子。场景要点：红笔、划掉的行、页边批注。

pos.zh: 编辑；校订；剪辑；删改；主编
编辑版本；一次编辑改动

senses.title: Revise a text
senses.titleCN: 校订文字：删、改、调整，让它更准确清楚
senses.definition: to read a piece of writing and change it in order to improve accuracy, clarity, or style
senses.definitionCN: 阅读一篇文字并作出修改，使其更准确、清楚或更合风格
senses.example: She edited the report twice before sending it to the board.
senses.exampleCN: 她把报告改了两遍才发给董事会。
senses.why: Latin edere meant 'to give out, bring forth'. Editing is the work that makes a text fit to be brought out in public: what cannot stand is removed, what is unclear is fixed.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 edere 意为“拿出来、产出”。编辑就是让文本适合公开“拿出来”的工作：站不住的内容删掉，不清楚的地方改好。

senses.title: Prepare for publication as editor
senses.titleCN: 主编：对整份出版物的内容负责
senses.definition: to be in charge of preparing a newspaper, magazine, or book for publication
senses.definitionCN: 负责把报纸、杂志或书准备到可出版的状态
senses.example: For ten years she edited the country's leading science magazine.
senses.exampleCN: 她主编这个国家最重要的科学杂志长达十年。
senses.why: The person who edits in this sense does not just fix sentences; they decide what enters the publication and what is left out. Editing becomes a form of gatekeeping.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项里的编辑不只改句子，还决定什么能进出版物、什么被挡在外面。编辑由此变成一种守门。

senses.title: Remove by editing
senses.titleCN: 删掉：把不该出现的部分剪出去
senses.definition: to remove words, scenes, or data from a text or recording
senses.definitionCN: 从文字或录音录像中移除词句、场景或数据
senses.example: The lawyer asked them to edit out the names of the children.
senses.exampleCN: 律师要求他们把孩子们的名字删掉。
senses.why: If editing is making a text fit to be shown, some material must be cut away. The phrasal verb edit out makes the cutting explicit: the piece is removed, not rewritten.
senses.whyCN: 如果编辑是让文本适合展示，就必须剪掉一些材料。短语动词 edit out 把这刀明说出来：那一块是被移走，而不是被改写。

senses.title: Cut and arrange film or sound
senses.titleCN: 剪辑：把拍好的片段重新排列成故事
senses.definition: to select and arrange shots or recorded sound to form a finished film or track
senses.definitionCN: 挑选并排列镜头或录音，形成完成的影片或音轨
senses.example: The director edited the scene so that the argument happens in silence.
senses.exampleCN: 导演重新剪了这个场景，让争吵发生在静默中。
senses.why: Film editing is the same operation as text editing, done with time instead of lines: keep this, drop that, move this earlier. The editor builds meaning by sequence.
senses.whyCN: 电影剪辑与文字编辑是同一个操作，只是用时间而不是行来做事：留这个、扔那个、把这个提前。剪辑者用顺序制造意义。

senses.title: Alter genetic material
senses.titleCN: 基因编辑：在生命的文本上改字
senses.definition: to change the DNA of an organism deliberately, adding, removing, or rewriting a sequence
senses.definitionCN: 有意改变生物的 DNA，增加、删除或改写一段序列
senses.example: The technique can edit a single letter in the genome.
senses.exampleCN: 这项技术能编辑基因组里的一个字母。
senses.why: DNA is written as a sequence of letters, so the language of editing transferred naturally. Gene editing treats the genome as a text that can be corrected at a specific position.
senses.whyCN: DNA 被写成字母序列，所以“编辑”的语言自然迁移过来。基因编辑把基因组当成一份可以在特定位置修正的文本。

senses.title: Adjust an image or photo
senses.titleCN: 修图：裁切、调色、去掉不要的部分
senses.definition: to change a photograph or image by cropping, adjusting colour, or removing elements
senses.definitionCN: 通过裁切、调色或移除元素来改变照片或图像
senses.example: He edited the photo to remove a stranger from the background.
senses.exampleCN: 他修了照片，把背景里的陌生人去掉。
senses.why: A photograph is now a file rather than a print, so changes are made by selection and deletion. The old editorial gestures — crop, cut, correct — survive in digital form.
senses.whyCN: 照片现在是文件而不是相纸，所以改动靠选取和删除完成。古老的编辑动作——裁、剪、改——以数字形式活了下来。

senses.title: Change data or a record
senses.titleCN: 修改数据：改动一条记录或一个字段
senses.definition: to change the contents of a file, database record, or settings field
senses.definitionCN: 改变文件、数据库记录或设置字段的内容
senses.example: Only administrators can edit the payment records.
senses.exampleCN: 只有管理员能修改付款记录。
senses.why: Any stored text can be edited: a record is a small document. In computing the word is neutral and technical, covering every deliberate change to stored content.
senses.whyCN: 任何被存下来的文本都能被编辑：一条记录就是一份小文档。在计算机里这个词中性而技术化，涵盖对存储内容的一切有意改动。

senses.title: Compile a collection
senses.titleCN: 编选文集：把多篇文字收成一本
senses.definition: to collect and prepare a group of texts, essays, or images for a single volume
senses.definitionCN: 收集并整理一组文字、文章或图像，编成一册
senses.example: Two historians edited a volume of letters from the war.
senses.exampleCN: 两位历史学家编了一卷战时书信集。
senses.why: An editor of a volume does not write it; they choose what belongs together and put it in order. Editing here is selecting and arranging, not rewriting.
senses.whyCN: 一卷文集的编者并不写它；他们选择哪些东西该放在一起，并把它们排好。这里的编辑是挑选与排列，而不是重写。

senses.title: One edited version or change
senses.titleCN: 编辑版本：一次改动后的成品
senses.definition: a version of a text or film after editing, or a single change made in an editing session
senses.definitionCN: 文字或影片编辑后的一个版本，或一次编辑中的单处改动
senses.example: The director's final edit is two minutes shorter than the cinema release.
senses.exampleCN: 导演的最终剪辑版比院线版短两分钟。
senses.why: The noun is the count version of the verb: an edit is one complete pass through the material, or one change produced by such a pass.
senses.whyCN: 名词是动词的可数版本：一次 edit 就是从头到尾处理一遍材料，或这一遍产生的某一处改动。

intro.en: Edit is a back-formation from editor, which English borrowed from Latin. The Latin verb edere meant 'to give out, bring forth' — publishing as bringing a work out into the open.
intro.cn: edit 是由 editor 逆构而成的，而 editor 是英语从拉丁语借来的。拉丁动词 edere 意为“拿出来、产出”——出版就是把作品带到公开之处。

items.en: Dare meant 'to give'. It is one of the most productive verbs in Latin, and it supplies the second half of edere.
items.cn: dare 意为“给”。它是拉丁语最能产的动词之一，也是 edere 的后半。

items.en: Edere meant 'to give out, bring forth, publish'. Its past participle editus is the source of edition, editor, and edit.
items.cn: edere 意为“给出、产出、出版”。它的过去分词 editus 是 edition、editor 与 edit 的来源。

items.en: Editor in Latin meant 'one who puts forth or publishes'. English borrowed it in the 17th century for the person who prepares a text.
items.cn: 拉丁语 editor 意为“拿出或出版某物的人”。英语在 17 世纪借入，指准备文本的人。

items.en: The verb edit is recorded in English in the late 18th century, most likely formed by removing the -or from editor. The noun came later.
items.cn: 动词 edit 于 18 世纪后期见于英语，很可能是从 editor 去掉 -or 逆构而来。名词义更晚。

items.en: As film, radio, and recording developed, edit extended from paper to shots and sound. The editor became the person who decides sequence.
items.cn: 随着电影、广播与录音的发展，edit 从纸张扩展到镜头与声音。编辑者成了决定顺序的人。

items.en: Word processors, photo software, databases, and gene technology all reuse the word. Anything represented as a sequence can now be edited.
items.cn: 文字处理软件、修图软件、数据库与基因技术都再次使用这个词。任何被表示为序列的东西，如今都能被编辑。

note.en: The first group is the edere/editor family; the second collects revise words, each with a different kind of change.
note.cn: 第一组是 edere/editor 词族；第二组收“修改”类近义词，每种改动方式不同。

entries.definition: a person who prepares texts or media for publication. English had editor before it had the verb edit.
entries.definitionCN: 把文字或媒体准备到可出版状态的人。英语先有 editor，后有动词 edit。

entries.definition: one published form of a book or newspaper. It comes from Latin editio 'a bringing forth'.
entries.definitionCN: 书或报纸的一个出版形态。它来自拉丁语 editio“产出”。

entries.definition: relating to editing or an editor; also a newspaper article stating the paper's opinion.
entries.definitionCN: 与编辑或主编有关的；也指表达报社立场的社论。

entries.definition: able to be edited. It applies the -able suffix to the verb edit.
entries.definitionCN: 可编辑的。它是把 -able 加到动词 edit 上。

entries.definition: to read again and change in order to improve. It stresses a second look; edit can also mean selecting and arranging.
entries.definitionCN: 重读并修改以求改进。它强调再看一遍；edit 还可指挑选与编排。

entries.definition: to make a small change, especially to a law or document. It is narrower and more official than edit.
entries.definitionCN: 对法律或文件作小改动。它比 edit 更窄、更正式。

entries.definition: to edit text for publication, especially to remove sensitive material. It comes from a different Latin root, redigere.
entries.definitionCN: 为出版而编辑文字，尤指删去敏感内容。它来自另一个拉丁词根 redigere。

entries.definition: to change something partly. It is broader than edit and does not imply improving or preparing for publication.
entries.definitionCN: 部分地改变某物。它比 edit 宽，不含“改进”或“准备出版”的意思。

normalIntro.en: Real parts and relatives: Latin edere 'give out' (e- + dare), and the family editor, edition, editorial, editable, unedited.
normalIntro.cn: 只用真实成分与同族词：拉丁语 edere“拿出”（e- + dare），以及 editor、edition、editorial、editable、unedited 词族。

normal.en: Edit was cut out of editor, just as the editor cuts things out of a text.
normal.cn: edit 是从 editor 里剪出来的，就像编辑从文本里剪东西一样。

normal.en: The Latin base is e- 'out' + dare 'give': to edit is to make a text fit to be given out.
normal.cn: 拉丁词基是 e-“出”+ dare“给”：编辑就是让文本适合被“发出去”。

normal.en: Editor, edition, editorial all come from the same 'bring forth' verb.
normal.cn: editor、edition、editorial 都来自同一个“产出”动词。

normal.en: In film, editing is choosing which shots to keep and in what order — text editing with time.
normal.cn: 在电影里，剪辑是选择留哪些镜头、按什么顺序——用时间来做的文字编辑。

normal.en: Gene editing works because DNA is written as letters; the word 'edit' fits the material.
normal.cn: 基因编辑能成立，是因为 DNA 被写成字母；edit 这个词正好贴合这种材料。

abstract.en: Editing is the art of deciding what the reader will never know was there.
abstract.cn: 编辑的艺术，是决定读者永远不会知道那里曾有什么。

abstract.en: Every cut is an argument about what matters.
abstract.cn: 每一刀删改，都是一次关于“什么才重要”的论证。

abstract.en: A text becomes itself only after something has been taken away.
abstract.cn: 一个文本只有在被拿走一些东西之后，才真正成为它自己。

examples.en: The journal rejected the paper but asked the authors to edit it and resubmit.
examples.cn: 期刊拒了这篇论文，但请作者修改后再投。

examples.en: He edited the interview down to four minutes for the evening news.
examples.cn: 他把握了采访剪到四分钟，用于晚间新闻。

examples.en: Scientists used the tool to edit a gene linked to the disease.
examples.cn: 科学家用这个工具编辑了一个与疾病相关的基因。

dict_mnemonic.text: “挨得特”——挨得特拿红笔一行行挨着改，删到只剩重点 → edit 编辑、删改

root: 源自拉丁语 edere“拿出、产出、出版”，由 e-“向外”+ dare“给”构成；英语先有 editor，后逆构出动词 edit，核心是“把材料修整到适合拿出去”。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses of edit, all one operation: look at a body of material, then cut, change, and rearrange it until it is fit to be shown.
sensesIntro.cn: edit 的九个义项都是同一个操作：审视一堆材料，然后删、改、重排，直到它适合被展示。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand with a red pen, crossing out, correcting, and moving lines on a page.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手拿红笔，在纸页上划掉、改正、挪动句子。

branches.en: TEXT: revising sentences, running a publication, and compiling a volume are three levels of the same editorial care.
branches.cn: 文本：改句子、管出版物、编文集，是同一份编辑功夫的三个层级。

branches.en: REMOVAL: edit out a name, cut a scene — meaning is built as much by what is taken away.
branches.cn: 移除：删掉一个名字、剪掉一个场景——意义同样由被拿走的东西构成。

branches.en: MATERIAL AS TEXT: genes and pixels are handled as sequences that can be cut and rearranged like words.
branches.cn: 材料当文本：基因与像素被当作可像文字一样剪接、重排的序列。

branches.en: RECORDS: a database row is edited like a sentence — a field is changed and the old value is replaced.
branches.cn: 记录：数据库的一行也像句子一样被编辑——改一个字段，旧值被替换。

branches.en: PRODUCT: an edit is one finished pass, the countable result of all that cutting.
branches.cn: 成品：一次 edit 就是完整的一遍，是所有删改的可数结果。

intro.en: Edit's family comes from Latin edere through editor and edition. The suffixes mark the person, the version, the attitude, and the possibility of being changed.
intro.cn: edit 的词族经 editor 与 edition 来自拉丁语 edere。后缀分别标记人、版本、态度与“可被修改”的可能性。

latinIntro.en: The reliable Latin forms are edere 'to give out', its participle editus, and editor 'one who puts forth'. These explain both the 'publish' core and the back-formed English verb.
latinIntro.cn: 可靠的拉丁形式是 edere“拿出”、其分词 editus，以及 editor“拿出某物的人”。它们解释了“出版”的核心与英语逆构动词的来历。

items.meaning: one who prepares text or media for publication
items.meaningCN: 把文字或媒体准备到可出版状态的人（-or 构成施事名词）
items.example: The editor returned the draft with thirty comments.
items.exampleCN: 编辑退回草稿，附了三十条意见。

items.meaning: one published version of a work
items.meaningCN: 一部作品的一个出版版本（-ion 构成名词）
items.example: The second edition corrects several maps.
items.exampleCN: 第二版更正了几幅地图。

items.meaning: relating to editing or to an editor's opinion
items.meaningCN: 与编辑有关的；表达编者意见的（-ial 构成形容词）
items.example: The paper published an editorial supporting the reform.
items.exampleCN: 报纸发表了一篇支持改革的社论。

items.meaning: in editorial matters, or as an editorial opinion
items.meaningCN: 在编辑事务上；作为编者意见（-ly 构成副词）
items.example: The magazine is editorially independent of its owner.
items.exampleCN: 这本杂志在编辑上独立于其所有者。

items.meaning: able to be changed or revised
items.meaningCN: 可编辑的；可修改的（-able 构成能力形容词）
items.example: The shared file is editable by everyone in the team.
items.exampleCN: 团队里每个人都能编辑这个共享文件。

items.meaning: not revised or cut
items.meaningCN: 未经编辑或剪辑的（un- 表示否定）
items.example: The archive released the unedited interview for the first time.
items.exampleCN: 档案馆首次公布了未剪辑的采访。

items.meaning: to edit again, often into a new version
items.meaningCN: 重新编辑；再剪一版（re- 表示“再次”）
items.example: The studio re-edited the film for its tenth anniversary.
items.exampleCN: 制片厂为十周年重新剪辑了这部电影。

items.meaning: to correct grammar, style, and consistency in a text
items.meaningCN: 对文稿做文字校对与统一（copy + edit 复合）
items.example: A freelancer copy-edited the manuscript before typesetting.
items.exampleCN: 排版前由一位自由职业者做了文字校对。

items.meaning: to prepare copy under a senior editor
items.meaningCN: 在主编之下做文稿编辑（sub- 表示“在下”）
items.example: She sub-edited the business pages for two years.
items.exampleCN: 她在商业版做了两年副编辑。

items.meaning: to remove a part while editing
items.meaningCN: 编辑时删去某部分（out 表示“出去”）
items.example: They edited out the pause before his answer.
items.exampleCN: 他们剪掉了他回答前的停顿。

latinEntries.meaning: to give out, bring forth, publish
one who puts forth or publishes

definition_zh: 元素；要素；成分；基本单位；（恶劣）天气；电热元件
definition_en: a basic substance that cannot be split chemically, a necessary part of a whole, or the natural conditions a person or thing belongs to
core_image: 一堆零件里最小的那几颗：再拆下去，就不是这个东西了。
scene: Water is not an element but a compound of hydrogen and oxygen.
sceneCN: 这里 element 是「化学元素」（第 1 个义项：不可再分的基本物质）；句意：水不是元素，而是氢和氧的化合物。场景要点：周期表、试管、被拆成两种气体的水。

pos.zh: 元素；要素；成分；基本单位；天气；元件

collocations.zh: 如鱼得水；处在最适合自己的环境里

derivatives.zh: 基本的；自然力的；元素的

senses.title: A chemical element
senses.titleCN: 化学元素：不能用化学方法再分的基本物质
senses.definition: a substance made of only one kind of atom, which cannot be broken down by chemical means
senses.definitionCN: 只由一种原子构成的物质，不能用化学方法再分解
senses.example: Carbon is an element; carbon dioxide is a compound.
senses.exampleCN: 碳是元素；二氧化碳是化合物。
senses.why: Elementum in Latin meant a first principle, something out of which other things are made. Chemistry kept the strongest version: the substances from which all matter is built.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 elementum 指“第一原理”，即构成其他事物的东西。化学保留了这个最强的版本：构成一切物质的那些基本物质。

senses.title: A necessary part of a whole
senses.titleCN: 要素：缺了它，整体就不成立
senses.definition: one of the parts that together make up a whole system, plan, or object
senses.definitionCN: 共同构成一个整体系统、计划或物体的部分之一
senses.example: Trust is the element that holds a long partnership together.
senses.exampleCN: 信任是维系长期伙伴关系的要素。
senses.why: If an element is a first building block, then any whole can be analysed into its elements. A successful project has elements: money, time, skill, and trust.
senses.whyCN: 如果 element 是第一批积木，那么任何整体都能被分析成若干要素。一个成功的项目有它的要素：钱、时间、技能与信任。

senses.title: A factor in a situation
senses.titleCN: 因素：影响结果的一个条件
senses.definition: a particular fact or quality that affects the outcome of a situation
senses.definitionCN: 影响局面的一个具体事实或性质
senses.example: The element of surprise gave the smaller team an advantage.
senses.exampleCN: 出其不意的因素给了较弱的一方优势。
senses.why: This is the part-sense applied to events rather than objects: a situation is a whole, and surprise, timing, or luck is one element in it.
senses.whyCN: 这是把“部分”义用到事件而非物体上：一个局面是整体，意外、时机或运气是其中的一个要素。

senses.title: One's natural environment
senses.titleCN: 如鱼得水的环境：最适合自己的地方
senses.definition: the surroundings or activity in which a person or animal is happiest and most competent
senses.definitionCN: 人或动物最自在、最能发挥所长的环境或活动
senses.example: On stage, among musicians, he is in his element.
senses.exampleCN: 在舞台上、乐手中间，他如鱼得水。
senses.why: The old four elements were earth, water, air, and fire; each creature belonged to one. To be in one's element is to be back in the medium one was made for.
senses.whyCN: 古老的四元素是土、水、气、火；每种生物各属于其一。in one's element 就是回到自己天生所属的那种介质里。

senses.title: Violent weather
senses.titleCN: 恶劣天气：风雨等自然力量
senses.definition: the forces of weather, especially wind and rain, when they are severe
senses.definitionCN: 天气的力量，尤其指风雨猛烈之时
senses.example: The climbers were exposed to the elements for two nights.
senses.exampleCN: 登山者在风雨中暴露了两夜。
senses.why: The elements here are the classical four, still imagined as powers rather than parts. To be out in the elements is to be unprotected before wind, water, and cold.
senses.whyCN: 这里的 elements 指古典四元素，仍被想象成力量而非零件。out in the elements 就是毫无遮拦地面对风、水与寒冷。

senses.title: A basic principle or rudiment
senses.titleCN: 基本原理：一门学问的第一块积木
senses.definition: one of the first and simplest principles of a subject
senses.definitionCN: 一门学科最初、最简单的原理之一
senses.example: The course teaches the elements of statistics before any software.
senses.exampleCN: 这门课先教统计学的原理，再碰软件。
senses.why: Elementum also meant the letters of the alphabet, the elements from which words are built. The elements of a subject are its alphabet: learn them before you write.
senses.whyCN: elementum 也指字母表，即构成单词的“元素”。一门学科的 elements 就是它的字母表：先学会，再动笔。

senses.title: A member of a set (mathematics)
senses.titleCN: 集合中的元素：属于某个整体的一员
senses.definition: an object or member belonging to a mathematical set
senses.definitionCN: 属于某个数学集合的对象或成员
senses.example: Every element of the set is an even number.
senses.exampleCN: 这个集合的每个元素都是偶数。
senses.why: Set theory needed a neutral word for 'a thing that belongs to a collection'. Element was ready-made: the smallest member out of which the collection is built.
senses.whyCN: 集合论需要一个中性词表示“属于某个集合的东西”。element 现成可用：构成集合的最小成员。

senses.title: A component of a story or design
senses.titleCN: 作品成分：叙事或设计中的组成单元
senses.definition: one of the recurring parts of a story, image, or design, such as character, setting, or colour
senses.definitionCN: 故事、图像或设计中反复出现的组成部分，如人物、场景或色彩
senses.example: The director uses silence as a structural element in every act.
senses.exampleCN: 导演在每一幕里都把静默当作结构性成分。
senses.why: A work of art is also a whole built out of parts. Critics call those parts elements to talk about composition without reducing the work to a list.
senses.whyCN: 艺术作品也是由部分构成的整体。评论者把这些部分叫作 elements，以便讨论构图，又不把作品降成一张清单。

senses.title: A heating or electrical component
senses.titleCN: 电热元件：电器里负责发热或工作的那一截
senses.definition: a part of a device that performs a specific physical function, especially one that heats or conducts
senses.definitionCN: 装置中执行特定物理功能的部分，尤指发热或导电的部件
senses.example: The heating element in the kettle had burned out.
senses.exampleCN: 水壶的加热元件烧坏了。
senses.why: This is the engineering use of the part-sense: a stove is a whole, and the coil that turns electricity into heat is one element of it.
senses.whyCN: 这是“部分”义在工程上的用法：炉子是整体，把电变成热的那圈线圈就是它的一个元件。

intro.en: Element comes from Latin elementum, a word for a first principle or rudiment. Its deeper origin is uncertain, which is why dictionaries disagree about where it came from.
intro.cn: element 来自拉丁语 elementum，指“第一原理、基础”。它更深的来源不确定，所以各家词典对它的来历说法不一。

items.en: Elementum meant 'first principle, rudiment' and also 'one of the four elements'. It was used to translate Greek stoikheion, 'a step, a first component'.
items.cn: elementum 意为“第一原理、基础”，也指“四元素之一”。它被用来翻译希腊语 stoikheion“一步、最初的组成部分”。

items.en: The origin of elementum is not established. Various suggestions exist, including a link to the alphabet sequence l-m-n, but no explanation is generally accepted, so it is safer to call it uncertain.
items.cn: elementum 的来源没有定论。存在各种猜测，包括与字母序列 l-m-n 相联系，但没有一种被普遍接受，所以更稳妥的说法是“来源不确定”。

items.en: English element first appears in the late 13th century for the four classical elements: earth, water, air, and fire.
items.cn: 英语 element 最早见于 13 世纪后期，指古典四元素：土、水、气、火。

items.en: As chemistry became a science, element was narrowed to a substance that cannot be decomposed chemically. This is the modern technical sense.
items.cn: 随着化学成为科学，element 被收窄为“不能用化学方法分解的物质”。这是现代技术义。

items.en: Set theory gave element the sense 'member of a set', while engineering used it for a functional part such as a heating element.
items.cn: 集合论给 element 增加了“集合成员”义，工程则用它指加热元件这类功能部件。

items.en: The word now covers chemistry, argument, weather, comfort, mathematics, art, and machines. In every case it names a smallest part or a medium you belong to.
items.cn: 这个词现在覆盖化学、论证、天气、自在感、数学、艺术与机器。每一种用法里，它都命名一个最小部分，或一种你所属的介质。

note.en: The first group is the element family, where elemental and elementary must be distinguished; the second collects part and factor words.
note.cn: 第一组是 element 词族，其中 elemental 与 elementary 必须分清；第二组收“部分”与“因素”类近义词。

entries.definition: relating to the four elements or to raw natural forces; basic and powerful. It is not the same as elementary.
entries.definitionCN: 与四元素或原始自然力有关的；基本而强烈的。它不等于 elementary。

entries.definition: concerned with the first simple principles; introductory. An elementary class starts at the beginning.
entries.definitionCN: 关于最初简单原理的；入门的。elementary class 从最基础开始。

entries.definition: the forces of weather, or the basic parts of a subject. The plural often has a meaning of its own.
entries.definitionCN: 风雨等自然力量，或一门学科的基础部分。复数常带独立含义。

entries.definition: in a basic or elemental way; with the force of a natural element.
